children: ), a market-leading medical technology company, today announced that members of the Company’s Executive Leadership Team will provide general business updates during fireside chats at the four following November healthcare conferences:
UBS Global Healthcare Conference on Mon., Nov. 9, from 11-11:35 a.m. EST in Palm Beach, Fla.
8th Annual Wolfe Research Healthcare Conference on Tues., Nov. 10, from 9:20-9:50 a.m. EST in New York City
Stifel Healthcare Conference 2026 on Wed., Nov. 11, from 9:20-9:50 a.m. EST in New York City
Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on Tues., Nov. 17, from 10-10:25 a.m. GMT (5-5:25 a.m. EST) in London

The discussions will be available to all interested parties who register to attend the webcasts, which are accessible via www.livanova.com/events. Listeners should log on approximately 10 minutes in advance to ensure proper webcast setup. Replays will be available on the LivaNova website within 24 hours after the live presentation.

LivaNova PLC is a global medical technology company built on nearly five decades of experience with a vision to change the trajectory of lives for a new day. Through ingenious medical solutions in select neurological and cardiac conditions, LivaNova strives to ignite patient turnarounds. With its registered office in the United Kingdom, approximately 3,300 employees, and a presence in more than 100 countries, LivaNova serves patients, healthcare professionals, and healthcare systems worldwide. For more information, please visit www.livanova.com.
